briefdescription.para: An operator to assemble a Poisson-like stiffness matrix using tensor product B-splines.

detaileddescription.para: The stiffness matrix has entries $ \int \alpha \nabla B_i \cdot \nabla B_j + \beta B_i B_j dx $ where $ B_i $ and $ B_j $ are tensor product B-splines.

The B-splines and the quadrature points both have a tensor product structure. The values and derivatives of the 1D B-splines at the 1D quadrature points are therefore stored (see detail_poisson::TensorBSplineStash) so that the tensor product B-splines can be evaluated at the quadrature points without being recalculated.

The poloidal grid type.
The 1D B-splines in the radial direction.
The 1D B-splines in the poloidal direction.
The radial quadrature grid type.
The poloidal quadrature grid type.
The type of the metric tensor associated with the mapping from the logical domain to the physical domain where the equation is defined.
The full index range of $ \phi $ including any batch dimensions. One matrix is assembled for each index in the batch dimensions.
